#!/bin/sh
set -eu

source_dir=/srv/inventory/data
backup_dir=/var/backups/inventory

if [ ! -d "$source_dir" ]; then
    printf 'Backup source is not a directory: %s\n' "$source_dir" >&2
    exit 1
fi

/usr/bin/install -d -o root -g root -m 0700 "$backup_dir"
exec 9>"$backup_dir/.inventory-backup.lock"
if ! /usr/bin/flock -n 9; then
    printf '%s\n' 'Another inventory backup is already running.' >&2
    exit 1
fi

timestamp=$(/usr/bin/date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%S.%NZ)
final_path="$backup_dir/inventory-$timestamp.tar.gz"
temporary_path=$(/usr/bin/mktemp "$backup_dir/.inventory-$timestamp.XXXXXX.tar.gz")
trap '/usr/bin/rm -f -- "$temporary_path"' 0 HUP INT TERM

/usr/bin/tar -C /srv/inventory -czf "$temporary_path" data
/usr/bin/tar -tzf "$temporary_path" >/dev/null
/usr/bin/chmod 0600 "$temporary_path"
/usr/bin/mv -- "$temporary_path" "$final_path"
trap - 0 HUP INT TERM

/usr/bin/find "$backup_dir" -maxdepth 1 -type f -name 'inventory-*.tar.gz' -printf '%T@ %p\0' \
    | /usr/bin/sort -z -nr \
    | /usr/bin/tail -z -n +8 \
    | /usr/bin/cut -z -d ' ' -f 2- \
    | /usr/bin/xargs -0r /usr/bin/rm -f --

printf 'Created %s\n' "$final_path"
ANTRIEB_INVENTORY_BACKUP
sh -n /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
stat -c '%A %a %U:%G %n' /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup

install -o root -g root -m 0700 /dev/null /usr/local/sbin/inventory-backup
